sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Please refer to the 'WNSWLHD_4304 Part B - Specifications' document.
1. Establish a formal contract for the provision of security services at Bourke and Walgett Multi-Purpose Services.
2. Ensure continuity of security coverage and appropriate security support.
3. Procure a service that delivers consistent, reliable and responsive incident management, including Code Black and duress response.
4. Ensure the service is compliant with NSW Health policy, legislative and regulatory requirements.
5. Support the provision of safe clinical environments through effective security presence and staff safety measures.
6. Enable a scalable and flexible service model aligned to operational demand and risk profile.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Please refer to the 'WNSWLHD_4304 Part B - Specifications' document.
WNSWLHD is referred to as The Agency.
The Service Provider is required to provide the Services at:
1. Bourke Multi-Purpose Services, 26 Tarcoon Street, Bourke NSW 2840, and
2. Walgett Multi-Purpose Health Service, 141 Fox Street, Walgett NSW 2832
The Agency may require for the Services to be expanded to other sites with agreement from the Service Provider.
Security Officers will be required to:
- Conduct regular surveillance of the staff accommodation units and their surrounds.
- Support staff walking to and from the main building and staff accommodation units.
- Participate in Lockup procedures.
- Respond to Code Black Alarms
- Assist clinical staff as required for any security issues.
- Visitation management
- Conduct regular surveillance/patrols of perimeter and buildings.
- Prevent unauthorised access to restricted areas.
- Conduct escort duties within the site.
- Complete personal and site log books.
The Service Provider must be able to increase security presence if required.
